## Overview

Part of the [**Data Science Projects Collection**](https://github.com/PaulChanCyber/Data-Science-Project-) (Movie Recommendation)—Collaborative/content-based movie recommender built from ratings and metadata.

## Problem & Data

Users need personalized suggestions beyond popularity lists.

## Approach

User–item matrix construction, similarity metrics (cosine/pearson), and top-N recommendation generation.

## Technologies

Python · pandas · scikit-learn · Jupyter

## Outcomes

Personalized movie lists with explainable similarity to past preferences.
